references.text: The Gershonite clans are mentioned here as part of the organization of the Levites, where Libni and Shimi make up the families of Gershon.
Gershon is mentioned as one of Levi's sons in the genealogical record of the Levites.
This verse gives details about which cities the Gershonites received from the tribes mentioned in verse 6.
Here are listed the specific cities that the Gershonite clan received from Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Manasseh, as mentioned in verse 6.
Gershon is mentioned as a son of Levi in the Levites' genealogical record.
A parallel account describing the cities given to the Gershonite clans from the same tribes.
Moses is commanded to give the Levites cities to live in from the inheritance of the other tribes, including pastureland around the cities.
